statement: Dolphin's Linux HIDAPI scanner accepts a candidate by Wii name or known VID/PID, not by a required L2CAP session; it tests a temporary raw-hid write of the status-request report before creating a WiimoteHidapi. ControllerInterface AddDevice then connects, prepares and links the real HID transport before running its own gyro initialization tasks. Discovery/connection is distinct from success in ControllerInterface tasks and also distinct from Dolphin real-Wii passthrough-to-game mode.
